profile.name: Rafael Campo
profile.title: Outbound Sales Representative — B2B Cold Calling & Pipeline Development
profile.text: Results-driven Outbound Sales professional with 3+ years of experience building and closing B2B pipelines from scratch through high-volume cold calling. Proven track record converting cold prospects into paying clients, managing 100+ active deals simultaneously in CRM systems, and consistently exceeding daily activity and revenue targets. Fluent, confident English communicator skilled in rapport-building, objection handling, and closing deals with U.S.-based decision-makers. Self-disciplined, coachable, and thrives in high-performance, metrics-driven sales environments.

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Representative (B2B Cold Calling)
achievements: Built and managed a personal outbound pipeline of 300+ B2B prospects from a cold, unqualified database, consistently generating 8-12 pitch conversations (10+ minutes) per day through high-volume manual dialing.

Converted cold outbound calls into paying clients, closing an average of 15+ deals per month with initial deposits ranging from $1,500 to $8,000, directly driving over $600K in cumulative closed revenue within 12 months.
Managed 100+ active deals simultaneously inside the CRM, maintaining disciplined follow-up cadences that increased pipeline-to-close conversion rate by 35%.
Handled high-frequency objections ("not interested," "too expensive," "already have a provider") daily, refining scripts and talk tracks that improved appointment-to-close rate by 20%.

Posted daily performance stats (dials, talk time, pitches, appointments, closes, deposits) in team Slack/Notion channels, maintaining full accountability and consistently ranking in the top tier of reps for activity volume.
Completed structured onboarding and coaching program, incorporating call review feedback weekly to rapidly improve pitch delivery, tonality, and objection handling within the first 60 days.

jobs.title: Client Implementation
achievements: Served as primary point of contact for enterprise clients during onboarding, building strong rapport and trust with stakeholders unfamiliar with the product.
Coordinated cross-functional communication between clients and internal teams, strengthening consultative communication and negotiation skills later applied to outbound sales.
